faults.level: end-to-end: mock HTTP -> QlooClient -> workflow -> FastAPI route

coverage_map.end_to_end_in_this_benchmark: HTTP status/exception/body faults at /search and /v2/insights, through the stateless route and /entities/search
coverage_map.unit_level_only_in_production_tests: adapter status-code and invalid-JSON mapping (tests/test_qloo_adapter.py); route and plan-route fault handling with injected QlooProviderError (tests/test_plans.py)
coverage_map.not_tested_offline_anywhere: real timeout durations, DNS/TLS failure, connection-pool exhaustion, retry/backoff (none implemented), response-size limits, real Qloo error-body shapes

live.status: none. The 43-request v1 spike ran against the stale 2b3f56c adapter and is historical, not evidence about the checkpoint.

phases.phase: L0 reachability probe of the checkpoint adapter
L1 entity-resolution gold: one /search per distinct gold query, to replace synthetic ids with reviewed real ids and measure real Recall@5/MRR
L2 six representative scenarios through the checkpoint workflow

planned_budget_for_next_slice.bounds: Insights calls per run are capped at 5 by Settings.qloo_max_insights_calls; no retries exist in the adapter, so a failed call is not repeated.
planned_budget_for_next_slice.authorisation: required separately; not requested or used in v2

human_evaluation.note: Protocol and scripts are retained (bench/human_eval.py). No participant data exists and none was fabricated.
